title: ansible.credential Facet
description: The OBSERVED existence of an AWX/AAP credential — NAME AND KIND ONLY — projected read-only by the ansible-automation Connector's controller half (ADR-0128 D2). It exists so that 'which templates use this credential?' is a graph TRAVERSAL (ansible.template --uses-credential--> ansible.credential) rather than a scan of an array of names, which is the estate-graph thesis applied to the system we are replacing. Demanded by the awx-credentials View. NOT a CredentialRef: this is the read-only mirror of a foreign object, exactly as ansible.template mirrors a job template, and CredentialRef is the frozen Named Kind it becomes when `stratt adopt` takes authority (§2). NO CREDENTIAL MATERIAL IS EVER PROJECTED (§2.5) — AWX returns $encrypted$ placeholders for secret fields and we do not read even those; this closed schema is what makes that a structural property rather than a promise. Closed (§9).

kind.description: AWX credential kind — ssh | vault | scm | vmware | aws | gce | azure_rm | … (the vendor's own rendering, quarantined under the ansible. prefix)
